tbt1 <- readRDS("Tabeta-fugu5.seurat.v3.rds")
library(rgl)
ggcolor <- function(n) {
  hues = seq(15, 375, length = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

meta <- tbt1@meta.data
plot3d(tbt1@reductions$umap_3d@cell.embeddings, xlab="UMAP_1", ylab="UMAP_2", zlab="UMAP_3", col=ggcolor(38)[meta$SCT_snn_res.4])
